expectations.text: Flags the nested comments and attachments resolvers as unscoped by tenant
expectations.evidence: "Nested resolvers do not independently enforce tenant ownership — [documents.ts:29]... `comments` and `attachments` query only by `documentId`."

expectations.text: Flags updateDocument for scoping on id alone without a tenant constraint
Flags exportWorkspace taking tenantId from the client-controlled request body
Flags searchDocuments as returning rows across all tenants
expectations.evidence: "Unscoped search — [documents.ts:65]... Any search can return document IDs and titles from all tenants."

expectations.text: Flags adminListDocuments as checking authentication but not authorization or tenant
expectations.evidence: "Admin listing is authenticated, not authorized or scoped — [documents.ts:75]... Any signed-in user can retrieve the 200 newest documents across every tenant."

expectations.text: Enumerates all the affected sites rather than fixing only the first one found
expectations.evidence: Lists six separate issues: exportWorkspace, searchDocuments, adminListDocuments, updateDocument, nested resolvers, author lookup

expectations.text: Recommends a structural device (scoped repository, row-level security, or equivalent) rather than only adding where-clauses site by site
expectations.evidence: "Put all tenant-owned tables behind PostgreSQL RLS... Expose a `TenantDb` / scoped repository constructed with `session.tenantId`"

expectations.text: Recommends a cross-tenant test that attempts tenant A operations against tenant B resources
expectations.evidence: "Add one table-driven two-tenant test: create tenants A and B, then attempt every read, search, export, nested resolver, update, and admin operation from A against B's resources"

expectations.text: Identifies the raw interpolation of tenantId into $queryRawUnsafe as an injection hazard distinct in kind from the tenant-scoping bug
expectations.evidence: "It also interpolates that value into `$queryRawUnsafe`, allowing an attacker to alter the SQL predicate and potentially export every tenant." — identified as separate attack vector from client-supplied tenant ID

expectations.text: Does not conclude the main query paths being scoped means the service is safe
expectations.evidence: "the scoped root queries are good, but the service is not tenant-safe overall"
